entry.title: Daikon: Period Tracker 1.9.0
entry.summary:
New: your own tags, with pain relief and the pill built in; a daily pill reminder; and a little card of your next period to share with your partner from Today. Full-screen ads now appear at most once a day, never when you open the app. A small banner sits at the bottom of Diary and History.
新增：自訂標籤，止痛藥和避孕藥也能記；每日吃藥提醒；在「今天」把下次經期做成小卡分享給伴侶。全螢幕廣告改為每天最多一次，打開 App 時不會出現。「日記」與「你的記錄」底部新增一則小橫幅。

entry.title: Lockwater: Canal Puzzle 1.3.0
entry.summary:
New level map: sail your tug along a 3D canal through all 12 chapters, from sunny locks to night water, and watch it chug to each lock you open. When no ad is available, the ad space shows one of our other apps. Bug fixes.
全新關卡地圖：拖船沿著 3D 運河穿過全部 12 章，從陽光水閘到夜色水道，每開啟一道新水閘就開過去。沒有廣告可顯示時，廣告位置會改為介紹我們的其他 App。另修正了一些問題。

entry.title: Roomory: Floor Plans 2.4.1
entry.summary:
Roomory 2.4.1 • More reliable iCloud sync: one project with a problem no longer holds back the others or shared projects • PDF, SVG and DXF exports draw low walls (railings, bar counters), and PDF sheets show the area of drawn rooms • Fixes to quotes, splitting and merging rooms, 3D doors and AR restyling • Stability and performance improvements
居圖 2.4.1 • iCloud 同步更可靠：單一專案出錯不再擋住其他專案與共享專案 • PDF、SVG、DXF 匯出會畫出矮牆（欄杆、吧檯），PDF 圖面也標出手繪房間的面積 • 報價、拆分與合併房間、3D 門扇與 AR 換材質的多項修正 • 穩定性與效能改善
